title: Jiuzhaigou Sells Out at 41,000 a Day — When to Actually Go | China Travel Expert
description:
Jiuzhaigou caps peak-season tickets at 41,000 a day — and over China's Golden Week they're gone days before you arrive.

This Sichuan valley is famous for water that glows blue-green: minerals in the rock (calcium carbonate / travertine) turn the lakes turquoise. In peak season (April–November) only 41,000 tickets are sold each day; off-season the cap drops to 23,000. During the October 1–7 Golden Week holiday that cap is reached days in advance, so show up without a booking and you simply won't get in. The colour peaks roughly October 15 to early November, strongest around October 20 — but that's also the busiest stretch.

🧭 Expert Tip: skip October 1–7, and aim for late September or early November — nearly the same colour, a fraction of the crowd. Book your dated ticket 5–7 days ahead on the official platform, and reconfirm before you travel; caps and dates change.
